_why: Starter lists for scripts/lib/cn-model-dispatch-gate.js (Fleet task 01M7E2A1, card d-1dfcf757). A repo extends every list (union, never replaces) in .claude/cn-model-gate.json, including review_roles. review_local_exceptions is not one of those lists: only this shipped file counts, because the window is the operator's decision (d-ede04b92, PM 01M7JPZQ), not a repo's. A repo cannot add, extend, or shrink an entry. core_unset_allow is the same kind of shipped-only list: when effective core_dirs is empty the gate treats every path as core unless it matches this list (or a New-Files path that does not exist yet), and a repo .claude/cn-model-gate.json cannot add to, replace, or shrink it (Fleet task 01M7S88YZPPZKVARP0F2SYMRGS, operator rule 2026-11-15 fail closed). core_unset_fixture_exts is shipped-only the same way: a path allowed only by **/fixtures/**, **/testdata/** or **/__fixtures__/** must have a basename extension in that list (lower-cased, the text after the last dot); a repo file cannot add, replace, or shrink it. docs/**, doc/** and an absent New-Files path have no extension rule. Globs: `*` stays inside one path segment, `**` crosses directories, a glob without `/` matches any single path segment.
